excludedExamples.reason: Gucci & Vuitton supplies attachments, not additional guns.
LesRaisins Tactical Equipements is melee/throwable support, distinct from the gun-adding Append Pack.
CursedGun unlocks attachment combinations on existing guns.
Gunpack Redistribution installs other packs rather than creating guns.
Fire Control Extension supplies behavior/API support.
Enchanted Arsenal adds enchantments to existing weapons.
Zombie Siege LootTables distributes existing TaCZ guns.
Yisu Manager Attachment Pack is attachment-only.
TaCZ Plus explicitly adds mechanics rather than guns.

scope: Creator-confirmed additional Java TaCZ guns only. Exclude base runtimes, other engines, skins/retextures, attachment-only packs, melee-only packs, ammo libraries, crafting recipes, optimization, compatibility, AI and loot distribution.
metricsPolicy: Keep source download counts, CurseForge favoriteCount and Modrinth followers separately. Do not sum repeated packaging/provider listings. No numeric community star rating is manufactured. Personal ratings remain browser-local.
